answer: Reaching the ivory of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. A vine of per-task receipts records who did what, and the reef of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
